daytypes.rule: A date is 'holiday' if it is a Karnataka general public holiday falling Monday-Saturday (list above); otherwise by IST calendar weekday: Mon-Fri weekday, Sat saturday, Sun sunday. Holiday dates present in the data: 2025-08-15 and 2025-09-05 (daily totals 668k and 648k, i.e. Saturday-like, vs ~780k normal weekdays). Only 2 holiday dates, so holiday medians are the mean of 2 days per hour.
